env_change_actions.add: create the key with `default` if it is absent
env_change_actions.remove: delete the key from the target file
env_change_actions.change_default: raise `old_default` to `new_default`, a custom value is preserved
env_change_actions.update_default: synonym of change_default (spelled this way in 2026.04-version-updates)

breaking_changes: OpenWebUI 0.8.8: model table schema changed (access_control column removed). model_sync updated automatically.
PostgreSQL max_connections increased from 400 to 800. Requires restart of postgres container.
llama.cpp updated from b7966 to b8196 in Vulkan Dockerfile. Requires rebuild of gpustack-vulkan image.

Per-service database users require running core/init-db.sh to create new users and grant permissions. Existing installs using shared POSTGRES_USER will continue to work until the user runs init-db.sh.
PostgreSQL image changed from pgvector/pgvector:pg17 to custom build with Apache AGE extension. Requires image rebuild.

PostgreSQL image reverted from custom Apache AGE build to standard pgvector/pgvector:pg17. LightRAG graph storage switched from PGGraphStorage (AGE) to NetworkXStorage (file-based). Existing AGE graph data in lightrag_db will no longer be used; re-indexing documents in LightRAG is required.

versions.description: Container version updates: Authentik 2025.10.4, FerretDB 2.7.0, Dify sandbox 0.2.14

breaking_changes: Cognee profile: FalkorDB container removed; cognee container now uses embedded Kuzu graph. Existing cognee_db data is preserved, but cognee's on-volume graph file is regenerated on first start of cognee 1.0.1 (disabled profile so no live impact for most deployments).
Hermes container base image changed from node:20-bookworm-slim to node:22-trixie-slim to drop a large chunk of the bookworm CVE backlog; requires rebuild (razzfazz-upgrade.sh does this).

docker-socket-proxy allowlist expanded (POST, ALLOW_START, ALLOW_STOP, ALLOW_RESTARTS, EXEC) so razzfazz-config, razzfazz-backup-management, agent-manager, authentik-worker, and gpustack can talk through the proxy. Five containers migrated off raw /var/run/docker.sock.
Gitea DISABLE_REGISTRATION is now hardcoded true (previously gated on ENABLE_GOOGLE_OAUTH). Public signup is closed on all deployments; Authentik SSO is the only path in.
Caddy rebuilt with github.com/mholt/caddy-ratelimit; Authentik login flow and Gitea /user/login rate-limited to 10 req/min per IP.

Authentik major version jump 2025.10 → 2026.2. Upstream 0056_user_roles migration is buggy; razzfazz.ai ships a sanitized overlay that skips the RunPython body (per-user/per-group object-level permission backfill). Stacks relying on Django-level object permissions need manual backfill — see docs/authentik-upgrade.md. All razzfazz.ai group-based permissions survive untouched.

COMPOSE_PROFILES `llm-box` / `llm-experimental` / `llm-cpu` are migrated to `llm` automatically by razzfazz-upgrade.sh Step 5b. Set HARDWARE accordingly. Rollback to the frozen 0.7.1 + Vulkan stack: replace `llm` with `llm-legacy` in COMPOSE_PROFILES.

Repo Layout-A reorg (#26): all per-module directories (chat, dify, llm, search, knowledge, doc-processing, monitor, observability, agents, gitea, stts, tools, apps) moved under modules/. The LLM device overlay therefore moved from llm/compose.devices.<HW>.yml to modules/llm/compose.devices.<HW>.yml. Existing boxes' live .env COMPOSE_FILE carries the old top-level path; razzfazz-upgrade.sh rewrites it in place via migrate_compose_file_to_modules_layout (Step 5b.0.5b) BEFORE composing, preserving any operator-added overlays. No operator action required, no new .env keys. core/ stays at repo root.

Dify 1.14.2 -> 1.15.0 (#26): 24 new Alembic revisions run automatically on dify-api start (MIGRATION_ENABLED=true) — nearly all additive; one data migration normalizes legacy end_user rows. Rollback path is the pre-upgrade Postgres volume backup (razzfazz-upgrade.sh --rollback), NOT an Alembic downgrade. Upstream 1.15 also mandates a one-shot 'flask backfill-plugin-auto-upgrade' AFTER 'flask db upgrade'; this is now wired automatically (run_data_migrations in cli/upgrade.sh, triggered exactly on the crossing into Dify >=1.15.0, retried until the migrated schema is ready, idempotent-ish).

env_changes.example_differs: #1148: .env.example ships rzfz-admin to NEW installs; an EXISTING box must keep akadmin because its per-user resources are username-slug-keyed. The disagreement IS the migration.

breaking_changes: LLM layer replaced: GPUStack 2.x (profile `llm`) is removed and the LLM Manager trio takes over. Models YOU added to GPUStack 2.x are no longer served — the weights stay in the volume, re-create the entries in the manager console. `llm-cpu`/`llm-legacy`/`llm-cuda` (GPUStack 0.7.1) are NOT affected. Hand your existing weights over with `rzfz adopt-models` BEFORE anything downloads: docs/enterprise/how-to/upgrade-to-2026.09.md

OpenAI-compatible API: the key changes. The URL keeps working; a client still sending GPUSTACK_API_KEY now gets `401 invalid API key`. Mint an `rzfz-sk-...` key per consumer in the manager console. Tell your API users BEFORE upgrading — they cannot mint one until the box is on 2026.09: docs/enterprise/how-to/migrate-openai-api-2026.09.md

Six vHosts need DNS and certificate coverage: settings, llm-manager, search, hub, openuem and wazuh under <domain>. Caddy serves them regardless of profile. The upgrade pre-flights ONLY settings.<domain>; on a Let's Encrypt box a missing record means a certificate Caddy cannot get, and with TLS_MODE=certificate the names must be in the SAN.
The configuration portal moved from config.<domain> to settings.<domain>. The old name 301-redirects for ONE cycle — move bookmarks, runbooks and monitoring checks.

Backup scope shrank: onyx-vespa-data (the Onyx search index) and clickhouse-data (the whole trace history) are excluded from the nightly backup by the new BACKUP_EXCLUDE_REGEXP default. They ARE still mounted. If you need them backed up, set BACKUP_EXCLUDE_REGEXP explicitly.

Open WebUI role management is switched ON (ENABLE_OWUI_OAUTH_ROLE_MANAGEMENT false -> true). A chat administrator who is in no permitted Authentik group is DEMOTED on next sign-in, and can be locked out. Verify your own account from a second browser session before you close the first.

Thin inference nodes: every LLM_NODE_* key becomes LLM_WORKER_*, and the container llm-node-agent becomes llm-worker-agent. No alias, no grace period. The rename is rename-or-refuse — if it fails the upgrade STOPS. Plan a maintenance window for the nodes.

Local debug ports moved: Agent Manager 5100 -> 5110 (5100 collided with PRESIDIO_ANALYZER_PORT), Cognee 8000 -> 8011. Both bind 127.0.0.1 — no firewall change, but local scripts and health checks silently find nothing.
Three always-on containers (llm-manager, llm-registry, llm-worker-agent) start on every box and cannot be switched off from the portal. Budget roughly 2.6 GB of additional RAM.

Open WebUI 0.10.2 -> 0.11.1 reorganises the chat interface, and LightRAG loses its built-in admin/admin123 account (sign-in is SSO only). Warn end users; screenshots and training material show the old layout.
